title: Vacuum gripper with bores for applying a negative pressure and a positive pressure

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a vacuum element and a vacuum element holder, but does not mention a housing with a grip portion or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion, let alone one that is a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe a vacuum generating device or a grip portion through which exhaust air is guided.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a grip portion or a sound-damping device.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper but lacks any mention of a grip unit with these specific features.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a vacuum element and a seal, but does not include a grip unit with the specified features of an electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust routing, and sound-damping device.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or any sound-damping material.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a vacuum generating device or a housing portion.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not describe a housing portion or a sound-reducing device/material.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or multiple housing portions with an air outlet.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw, a grip portion, or a first housing portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion, air baffles, or an air outlet.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not describe a battery coupling point, a second housing portion, or air baffles.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit or a suction plate that are releasably connected.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit or a suction plate that delimits a suction chamber.

claims.note: This reference describes a vacuum gripper for taking in and holding workpieces, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device for use with a suction plate.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper with a vacuum element and a vacuum element holder, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper but does not mention any sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not disclose a grip portion lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a vacuum element and a vacuum element holder, but does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a vacuum gripper with a vacuum element and a holder, but does not mention a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet on a second housing portion.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper, but does not disclose an air collection device, an air collection screw, or the concept of collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.
This reference describes a vacuum gripper, but does not mention air baffles, bent or curved, for guiding exhaust air from a grip portion to an air outlet.

This reference describes a vacuum gripper, but does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum gripper for taking in by pressure and holding work pieces.
claims.note: The abstract describes a vacuum gripper for taking in and holding workpieces, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.

claims.quote: Said gripper comprises a vacuum element (1) configured as an elastic shaped element and a vacuum element holder (2).
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum element (seal) and a vacuum element holder (carrier plate), but does not explicitly state the seal is fastened to the carrier plate or extends around it. It states the seal is configured in the vacuum element.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper, but does not include the specific features of 'claim 1' of the subject invention, which is not provided in this context.
The reference describes a suction gripper with a vacuum element and a holder, but does not mention a releasable coupling device between a grip unit and a suction plate.

claims.quote: Said gripper comprises a vacuum element (1) configured as an elastic shaped element and a vacuum element holder (2). Said vacuum element holder comprises a first bore (3) for applying a negative pressure thereto
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper with a vacuum element and a holder, where the holder has a bore for applying negative pressure, which is equivalent to a suction opening connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a bore for applying negative pressure but does not teach a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate as claimed.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper for holding workpieces, which is a related field, but it lacks the specific features of a grip portion, an electrically operated vacuum generating device, and sound-damping elements.
